thread:
Avery T: Heads-up team — woke up to a flurry of ownership flips on inbound leads in EMEA overnight. many cases show owner assigned -> claim event -> reassign within 30s. likely enrichment webhook race + RR timeout.
Priya S: saw those alerts. median enrichment latency jumped to 18s for that window. Round-robin timeout is 20s, so it’s basically a race.
Carlos M: Ops log shows duplicate webhook deliveries from HubSpot retries causing stale owner writes. can we have idempotency on assignments (idempotency_key = lead.create_ts + source_id)?
Nina V: Good call. Also propose a "hold-assignment" short window: on create, wait 5m for enrichment to finish before running RR, but only for leads with enrichment_required=true. That should cut flapping.
Evan J: 5m seems long for some SLAs. Alternative: quick-assign (fast path) only if enrichment presents required_fields; otherwise set claim_suppress_until = now + 5m and flag for queued-assign.
Avery T: Love the hybrid. Quick path if enrichment_ready==true AND confidence>0.8. Otherwise queue for 5m.
Priya S: We should also add a lightweight pre-enrich cache: cache enrichment status per external_id for 2m so retries hit the cache instead of re-triggering pipelines.
Carlos M: For Salesforce mapping, add an assignment write guard: write_owner_if(last_owner_changed_at == null OR now - last_owner_changed_at > 300s). that prevents micro-reassigns.
Nina V: Frontline playbook: 1) If lead shows claim_count>3 within 10m, mark "assignment_noise" and pause auto-assign for 30m. 2) Notify #sales-inbound with sample lead IDs.
Evan J: Metrics to add: "assign_flaps_per_hour", "assign_latency_p95", "enrichment_ready_ratio". Alert if flaps > 5/hr for a region.
Priya S: Quick HubSpot workflow pseudo: 
```
# HubSpot workflow (pseudo)
IF enrichment_required == true AND enrichment_ready == false THEN set property 'assign_mode' = 'deferred' AND set 'suppress_until' = now + 5m
ELSE set 'assign_mode' = 'quick'
```
Carlos M: API/assignment service check (pseudo): 
```
// assignment request handler
if(lead.assign_mode == 'deferred' && now < lead.suppress_until) {
  enqueue(lead, 'deferred-assign-queue')
  return
}
// idempotency guard
if(request.idempotency_key == last_request_key) return last_result
if(now - lead.last_owner_change < 300s) return NOOP
proceed_with_assign()
```
Avery T: Rollout plan: feature flag "deferred_assign_hs". Canary to EMEA nights (00:00-06:00) for 48h. success criteria: assign_flaps_per_hour down >= 45% AND lead_response_sla impact < 5%.
Nina V: Also include a fast rollback: toggle off feature flag -> reprocess deferred queue immediately. ops-bot can run rehydrate job: re-enrich stale leads.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: deferred_assign_hs (default=false). Monitor: marketing.assign_flaps_per_hour, marketing.assign_latency_p95.
Evan J: I'll draft the PR and include unit tests for idempotency and suppress window. Suggested PR summary: "deferred_assign_hs: hybrid quick/deferred assignment to reduce ownership flapping caused by enrichment/webhook retries; adds idempotency and assignment-noop guard; canary to EMEA nights."
Priya S: Nice. Quick sync in 15m to assign owners for the PR and dashboard cards? 11:15 PT for me.
Carlos M: can do. I'll bring webhook retry logs and a sample rehydrate script.
Avery T: Thanks all — objective: cut micro-reassigns and noisy owner churn while keeping SLA intact. Post-call update here.
